scope: Phase P1 of docs/live-circuit-platform-revamp.md: the Live Circuit viewer and observer moved from sfx-embody demo/ to sfx-platform live-circuit/. Local verification only; no image was built, no slot was bound, no database row was written.

move.bytePolicy: live-circuit/.gitattributes sets -text; one retained capture (dispatch-pair/observation-capture.v1.txt) carries CRLF

changesAfterMove: circuit/live-store.mjs and circuit/deck-store.mjs resolve the estate directory from SDA_ESTATE_DIR, defaulting to two levels up (the image layout /opt/sfx/estate is unchanged)
live-circuit/package.json declares type module only, so Node loads the ES module .js files without re-parsing under the repository's Next.js package.json; it is not packaged
README and usage comments name live-circuit/ paths and link estate documents by repository

deploy/sda-kernel/live-circuit.mjs is the single placement of live-circuit/ into runtime/estate/demo/; prepare.mjs, prepare-identity.mjs and prepare-retrieval.mjs use it and refuse the retired estate-directory argument

packaging.method: Each packager run in a scratch directory with stand-in published hosts, a stand-in kernel manifest and stand-in SDA API files; packaged circuit files compared by SHA-256 with live-circuit/
packaging.note: prepare.mjs archives the kernel with tar; on Windows the run used bsdtar (System32). The runbook still directs complete releases to Linux.

observerParity.method: The estate-hosted observer on 8787 and the moved copy on 8788 (SDA_ESTATE_DIR=sfx-embody) read the live database through the same installed kernel delivery; responses compared

acceptanceScriptParity.method: Each script run from sfx-embody demo/ and from live-circuit/ with the same retained estate inputs; exit status and output compared after normalizing the viewer path and timestamps
acceptanceScriptParity.failingIdenticallyAtBothLocations: 8 cases whose retained inputs no longer fit the scripts (design-review-scene.json: Unexpected end of JSON input; a capture without a complete matching run; run start/end process identities). These are pre-existing input mismatches, not move effects.

notEstablished: Browser Observe, external CLI follow and replay in a browser were not exercised in this local check
No image built from the new packagers; the first release from live-circuit/ must pass the runbook section 7 gates
